remarks: Three Bedroom 2 bath Ranch home sitting on 2.8 acres in the Town of Charlotte.  Country roads lead you to a private wooded area that sits up on a knoll with rolling acreage and views.  The home has a spacious living room with large bay windows for viewing the scenery.  The kitchen is an L-Shaped Kitchen with plenty of cupboard storage and counter space, the formal dining area offers a large window that looks out to the backyard space.  The first floor bath is spacious and offers convenience. The home needs full renovation, including kitchen and baths. From the Dining/Living room there is open access to a basement lower level which could be finished for more living space.  The laundry is located on the lower level.  There is another room that could be finished, and a large area for entertainment, utility room. There is also a full bath with a shower, and egress from the lower level to the backyard.  There is a garden shed for storage, a deck on the front of the home, and a space for a pool or hot tub.  There is currently a hot tub on the property that does not work.  Seller does not warrant the condition of the property.  There are currently no utilities on at the property.  Bring a flashlight. All offers to be made by the buyer's agent on PropOffers.com.  Please do not walk the property without an agent.
